audit.why: full phases[N].side and content win[N] agree on every row and match the packet chart: Akali 1-3, Skill at 4-5, Yi at 6 and first item, Akali at 2+ items.

audit.whatIsWrong: The level 6 spike is justified by a false mechanic (Alpha Strike targeting her through Shroud) rather than by what actually changes at 6.
audit.why: Highlander is 85s and its real value here is slow immunity against her Q slow plus the Move/Attack Speed to stay on her. Perfect Execution is 120/90/60s.
audit.corrected: spikes[1].text, whys[4] and mid rebuilt on Highlander's 85s slow immunity; spikes[3] now carries the R execute threshold and its 60s rank-3 cooldown.

audit.whatIsWrong: Two false interactions. (a) The content layer says Alpha Strike dashes through Twilight Shroud and stays locked on her — Riot's text says she is 'unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks' inside it, and the full layer already states the opposite. (b) Five Point Strike is repeatedly said to heal her; it deals damage and slows, with no heal anywhere in her kit.
audit.why: The two layers currently render contradictory advice on the single most important interaction in the matchup, and the heal claim makes a player concede trades that are actually winnable.
audit.corrected: Alpha Strike cannot select her inside Twilight Shroud (20/19/18/17/16s) — commit after the Shroud is spent. Q slows, it does not heal. Assassin's Mark is an empowered auto with bonus range, triggered by leaving the ring her spell damage creates — the wind-up is the burst tell.

audit.whatIsWrong: Nothing on the page tells you to track the execute threshold as a number.
audit.why: Perfect Execution's recast executes below an HP threshold, so a health bar that looks survivable is not.
audit.corrected: Added to spikes[3].text, with Alpha Strike's untargetability as the answer.

edits.before: Your Highlander comes online and you can Q Alpha Strike straight through her W (Twilight Shroud) to stay locked onto her — the untargetable dash ignores the smoke's stealth for the duration. This is where the matchup starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Highlander (85s) comes online: slow immunity beats her Q slow so she cannot kite you. Alpha Strike still cannot select her inside Twilight Shroud (20s at rank 1), so wait the smoke out or walk her out of it — commit only once the Shroud is spent.

edits.before: Akali bullies you early: her Q (Five Point Strike) pokes and heals off passive, and once she has E (Shuriken Flip) she can mark and burst you. You have no reliable answer, so farm at max range and dodge her Q with sidesteps since it's a cone, not point-blank.
edits.after: Akali bullies you early: Five Point Strike (Q) pokes and slows, and once Shuriken Flip (E, 16s at rank 1) lands she recasts to dash in and burst you. You have no true damage until E, so farm at max range and leave her passive ring before she procs the empowered auto.

edits.before: Akali stays a threat because her R (Perfect Execution) two-part dash and shroud let her assassinate and reset — if she gets ahead she deletes you before you stick. Ping for a peel or an early Wit's End/QSS-style answer to her burst.
edits.after: Akali stays a threat: Perfect Execution's second cast (60s at rank 3) executes below an HP threshold, so track the number rather than the bar. Alpha Strike's untargetability dodges it outright — hold Q for her R, never for the chase.

edits.before: Akali's level 1 Q out-pokes you and heals her through your basics.
edits.after: Akali's Five Point Strike out-ranges and out-pokes your level 1 autos.

edits.before: At 2 her Q-plus-passive sustain keeps her comfortably ahead of your kit-less trades.
edits.after: At 2 her Q slow plus her passive's empowered auto keeps her ahead of your trades.

edits.before: At 6 your Highlander and Q dash through her shroud tilt the fight to you.
edits.after: At 6 Highlander's slow immunity and 85s uptime let you stick to her instead.

edits.before: Levels 1-3 are Akali's: her Q pokes and self-heals and you have no way to trade back, so hold max distance and only last-hit.
edits.after: Levels 1-3 are Akali's: her Q pokes and slows and you have no true damage yet, so hold max distance and only last-hit.

edits.before: By level 4-5 it evens as you get Wuju Style, and at 6 Highlander plus Q Alpha Strike through her shroud lets you finally pin her down.
edits.after: By 4-5 Wuju Style's true damage evens it, and at 6 Highlander's slow immunity beats her Q slow so she can no longer kite you off.

edits.before: Reach 6 and use Q to dash onto her through the shroud
edits.after: Reach 6 and commit only after Twilight Shroud is spent

edits.before: Poke you down with Q and heal off its passive
edits.after: Poke you down with Q and empowered passive autos

notes: The content layer and the full layer disagreed outright on whether Alpha Strike can target Akali inside Twilight Shroud. Riot's W text ('unable to be selected by enemy spells and attacks') settles it — the full layer was right, the content layer was rewritten. The 'her Q heals her' claim is false and the mirror audit reports it may appear on other Akali pages too. Untested and therefore left off the page: whether Alpha Strike can be cast while a mark from Shuriken Flip is on you, and whether Perfect Execution's execute checks HP on cast or on landing.
